subject: Invoice account mapping & capacity upgrade schedule
messages:
From: Elena Soto <elena.soto@heliosai.com>
To: irene.choi@redwoodinference.com
Cc: procurement@heliosai.com
Date: Fri, 2 Mar 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Invoice account mapping & capacity upgrade schedule

Hi Irene,

Thanks again for the demo last week — the Redwood Dedicated performance looks like a good fit as we ramp Q3 workloads. Finance wants to get the billing and PO in place ahead of the renewal so we can align our purchase order and internal approval flow. A few things we need to confirm from your side: 

- Can Redwood invoice to our newly-created entity (HeliosAI Cloud Services, EIN: 12-3456789)? Were in the middle of a legal reorg and procurement needs the invoice payor to match that entity.
- Our legal team requested a short addendum to reflect the 36-month committed capacity bump (additional 4x vGPU pool). Can you confirm if Redwood needs a signed addendum or if a PO referencing the amendment is sufficient to trigger provisioning?
- Net terms: Procurement prefers Net45 for this commit. Is that something Redwood can approve under a finance-accepted amendment?
- Attached is the PO draft (Helios_PO_2028.pdf). Please confirm the billing contact we should list on the invoice and any tax forms Redwood needs from us (W-9 / W-8BEN-E).

Elena
Procurement Lead | HeliosAI
elena.soto@heliosai.com
+1 (415) 555-0198

Attachment: Helios_PO_2028.pdf (application/pdf)

From: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwoodinference.com>
To: Elena Soto <elena.soto@heliosai.com>
Cc: laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com
Date: Fri, 2 Mar 2028 10:27:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Invoice account mapping & capacity upgrade schedule

Hi Elena — thanks for the clear summary and the PO. Copying Laura (Finance) so she has the draft. A few quick answers and requests below: 

- Invoicing entity: We can invoice "HeliosAI Cloud Services" provided the EIN matches your PO and the account owner confirms the payor mapping. Please confirm the exact remittance address to print on invoices.
- Addendum vs PO only: For capacity increases tied to a renewal, Redwood requires a signed amendment for multi-year committed capacity changes that alter billing cadence or pricing. The PO can reference the amendment, but our billing/operations team needs the signed addendum before we finalize the committed pool provisioning schedule. Ive attached our billing instructions / addendum template for your legal team to review.
- Net terms: Net45 is feasible for this customer under finance approval; Ill escalate.
- Tax forms: If HeliosAI is a US entity (EIN provided), we need a completed W-9. If not, we need a W-8BEN-E. Please attach whichever applies.

Next steps I propose:
1) Helios signs the Redwood Addendum (or confirms redlines) and returns it.
2) Procurement provides signed PO referencing the addendum and confirms remittance details.
3) Finance (Laura/Vivek) review and approve Net45; provisioning scheduled once the signed addendum is received.

Ill loop in Finance for the Net45 review — Laura, Vivek: can you confirm acceptance and any required approvals on your side?

Best,
Irene Choi
Account Director, Enterprise | Redwood Inference
irene.choi@redwoodinference.com

- We receive the signed addendum referencing the exact committed GPU pool and pricing (to avoid mid-term billing disputes).
- Procurement provides the completed W-9 (or W-8BEN-E) and the remittance address to match the PO.
